season.short_description: Season of the weekly count, written as 2024-25.
season.long_description: Season the count belongs to. Flu counts restart each August.

vaccine.short_description: Flu (seasonal influenza vaccine, adults 18+) or rsv (RSV vaccine, adults 50+).
vaccine.long_description: Vaccine the count refers to. For flu, seasonal influenza vaccine doses given to adults 18 and older (2019-20 season onward). For rsv, RSV vaccine doses (Arexvy, Abrysvo, or mResvia) given to adults 50 and older regardless of risk status, because the claims data cannot identify high-risk conditions.

setting.long_name: Setting where the vaccine was administered
setting.short_description: Where the doses were given: Pharmacy, Physician Medical Office, or Combined.
setting.long_description: Setting where the doses were administered. Combined is the sum of retail pharmacies and physicians' medical offices.

age.short_description: Age group of the people vaccinated.
age.long_description: Age group of the people vaccinated, as published by CDC.

iqvia_doses.long_name: Estimated vaccine doses administered during the week
iqvia_doses.short_description: Estimated number of doses given during the week.
iqvia_doses.long_description: CDC's estimate of the number of vaccine doses administered in the setting during the week, projected from IQVIA claims data. Physician office estimates can rise for about two months as claims are processed. These are counts of doses and cannot be used to calculate coverage.
iqvia_doses.statement: About {value} doses were administered in pharmacies and physician offices in the week ending {time}

iqvia_cumulative_doses.short_description: Estimated number of doses given from the start of the season through the week.
iqvia_cumulative_doses.long_description: Cumulative estimated doses from the start of the season through the week. RSV totals count doses given since August 2023.

iqvia.name: IQVIA pharmacy and physician-office vaccination claims (CDC estimates)
iqvia.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, using IQVIA data
iqvia.location: Weekly Cumulative Estimated Number of Influenza (and RSV) Vaccinations Administered in Retail Pharmacies and Physicians' Medical Offices, Adults, United States (FluVaxView and RSVVaxView dashboards)
iqvia.description: CDC publishes weekly estimates of the number of flu and RSV vaccine doses given to adults in retail pharmacies and physicians' medical offices in the United States. The pharmacy estimates are projected by IQVIA from prescription claims covering about 41,000 of the roughly 57,000 U.S. retail pharmacies, and the physician office estimates are projected from medical claims for a sample of office-based physicians. Doses given in workplaces, long-term care facilities, public health clinics, and hospitals are not included. The estimates are national dose counts with no denominator, and CDC states they should not be used to calculate vaccination coverage. Physician office estimates continue to rise for about two months as claims are processed.
iqvia.restrictions: Public domain as published by CDC on data.cdc.gov. The estimates are CDC projections derived from proprietary IQVIA pharmacy and physician-office claims data; reuse should attribute them to CDC FluVaxView/RSVVaxView and note that they are based on IQVIA data.

_catalog.summary: CDC's weekly estimates of how many flu and RSV vaccine doses adults received at retail pharmacies and doctors' offices nationwide, based on IQVIA claims data.
